mapper.select:
select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as 'date',
IFNULL(sum(mete),0) as mete
IFNULL(sum(mete),0) / 1000 as mete
from project_receiving_record where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType} group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as 'date',
IFNULL(sum(actual_mete),0) as mete
IFNULL(sum(actual_mete),0) / 1000000 as mete
from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType} group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')

select a.product_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification, a.quantity - IFNULL(b.quantity,0) - IFNULL(c.quantity,0) as quantity,
a.mete - IFNULL(b.mete,0) - IFNULL(c.mete,0)as mete
(a.mete - IFNULL(b.mete,0) -IFNULL(c.total_length,0)) / 1000 as mete
from ( SELECT product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification, sum(quantity) as quantity, sum(mete) as mete, sum(total_area) as totalArea FROM project_receiving_record where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType}
and #{yearMonth} >= DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
and #{yearMonth} > DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification ) a left join ( select product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification, sum(actual_quantity) quantity, sum(actual_mete) mete, sum(actual_total_area) as totalArea from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType}
and #{yearMonth} >= DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
and #{yearMonth} > DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification )b on a.product_id = b.product_id left join ( SELECT a.product_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification, sum(a.reject_quantity) as quantity,
IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.net_weight),0) as mete
IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.length),0) as total_length
FROM project_reject_detail a
left join tech_artifact as b on a.product_id = b.id
left join tech_enclosure as b on a.product_id = b.id
where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.review_status = 2 and a.project_id = #{projectId} and a.product_type = #{productType}
and #{yearMonth} >= DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m')
and #{yearMonth} > DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY a.product_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification )c on a.product_id = c.product_id where a.quantity - IFNULL(b.quantity,0) - IFNULL(c.quantity,0) > 0

SELECT product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification,
sum(quantity) as quantity,
sum(mete) as mete
ifnull(sum(mete),0) / 1000 as mete
sum(actual_quantity) quantity,
sum(actual_mete) mete
ifnull(sum(actual_mete),0) / 1000 as mete
FROM
project_receiving_record
project_install_report
where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType} and #{yearMonth} = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY product_id, monomer_id, area_id, name, serial_number, specification

select DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') as 'date',
IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.net_weight),0) as mete
IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.length),0) / 1000 as mete
from project_reject_detail a
left join tech_artifact as b on a.product_id = b.id
left join tech_enclosure as b on a.product_id = b.id
and a.review_status = 2 where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.project_id = #{projectId} and a.product_type = #{productType} group by DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT a.product_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification, -sum(a.reject_quantity) as quantity,
-IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.net_weight),0) as mete
-IFNULL(sum(a.reject_quantity * b.length),0) / 1000 as mete
FROM project_reject_detail a
left join tech_artifact as b on a.product_id = b.id
left join tech_enclosure as b on a.product_id = b.id
where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.review_status = 2 and a.project_id = #{projectId} and a.product_type = #{productType} and #{yearMonth} = DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY a.product_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification
,a.category
